method: Native Export modes and Import mode through computer-use; Save/Open/Replace handled through macOS dialogs; Plugin API for seeding, reading numeric values and building named diagnostic layers
scope: Update existing modes, 28 roundtrip variables plus 24 probes and 5 HSL unit cases in each of two profiles
notes: All native imports were performed through Figma UI, not through a custom JSON parser writing variables.
Seeded variables use RGBA 0.03125, 0.0625, 0.125, 0.75; unchanged values identify skipped tokens.
HSL immediate exports were taken before browser reload and without intervening Plugin API calls.
Separate native .fig copies preserve final states after reload; their reimport was not repeated in this run.
The reusable board helper was executed and its final layout adjusted; layer IDs and final bounds are archived.
Installed bundle version is recorded; Figma service build was not available.
